title: Das Kirchenbuch zu Gröben (1578-1769)
notes: Transcription, spread by spread (two pages per web page, with facsimile), of the church register begun in 1578: baptisms, marriages, burials, plus some inserted documents such as a letter of Melanchthon. The site covers 1578-1769; the part dated 1578-1700 is 248 page spreads (pages 1 to c. 505). The count of about 71,800 words is ours, from those spreads (page labels and navigation text excluded; spreads marked as later inserted documents left out). The site footer reads © 2009 EKBO and its news feed was last updated on 18 March 2014, so it is listed as archived.
